game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Keyword Switchboard: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches. Each round, blizzard sprites strike the larder door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the wires value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the larder door from blizzard sprites in Chimney Roofs: keep the wires meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: wires drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Keyword Switchboard
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
